snapshot.text: Dual system of public insurer FONASA and private ISAPREs. The Kast government took office in March 2026 facing long waiting lists and budget pressure; Minister Chomali chaired PAHO's 63rd Directing Council.

priorities.title: Waiting lists and cancer care
priorities.text: A health alert gives flexibility to fund more than 27,000 delayed oncology treatments; the 2027 budget rises 4.7% with a focus on management, efficiency and shorter waiting lists.

priorities.title: Mental health and access
priorities.text: In her first public account the minister announced 50 new community mental health centres and highlighted Chile's certification as the first country in the Americas to eliminate leprosy.

priorities.title: Digital transformation
priorities.text: The ministry is using AI and new information technology to make public health management more efficient, building on the minister's background in health information systems.

netherlands.text: Ties are mainly trade and innovation; an RVO market study maps openings for the Dutch health sector in Chile's digital health and hospital plans. No current government-to-government health track found.

institutions.name: Instituto de Salud Pública
institutions.role: National public health institute and regulator

timeline.text: Kast government takes office; May Chomali becomes health minister.
Health alert to fund more than 27,000 delayed cancer treatments.
First public account: 50 new community mental health centres, leprosy elimination certified.
Report: waiting times for non-GES surgery rose in seven health services.
Chomali chairs PAHO's 63rd Directing Council in Washington.
